def transform(grid):
    # Each 3x3 patch represents its non-background color, if any.
    out = []
    for br in range(0, len(grid), 3):
        row = []
        for bc in range(0, len(grid[0]), 3):
            colors = [grid[r][c]
                      for r in range(br, min(br + 3, len(grid)))
                      for c in range(bc, min(bc + 3, len(grid[0])))
                      if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
            row.append(colors[0] if colors else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
